summary:

- Client: ABENER TEYMA SOLANA

summary_points: Document title: HTF & Molten Salts Hydraulic Circuits Calculation Report
Client: ABENER TEYMA SOLANA
Project: Solana
Document number: 4521-CAL-AEE-58-11-0001-GAR, Revision: 02
Purpose: Evaluate implications of replacing existing TES System plate heat exchangers with tube and shell heat exchangers
Simulation using Pipeflo® for both HTF and Molten Salts circuits under various operating cases
Molten salts circuit includes 6 identical and independent circuits with specific equipment
Assumptions include pipe details, tank pressures, temperatures, pump heights, and more
Report on HTF and Molten Salts hydraulic circuits calculations
Assumptions based on 3D model, P&IDs, and heat exchanger datasheets
Simulation results for Molten Salts circuit with two scenarios: max and min operating points
Heat Exchanger process data including mass flow, pressures, and HEX pressure drop
Pump performance adjusted to maximize control valve opening
HTF Circuit process data similar to Heat Exchanger
Simulation results showed no issues with existing pumps and heat exchangers.
New set of heat exchangers and installed pumps can handle all operation cases.
Pumps can run below maximum speed (1132 rpm) and control valves at more than 50% opening.
Reference documents include various specifications and performance curves.
Annex I contains results for Molten Salts operation scenarios.
Annex II contains results for HTF circuit operation scenarios.
